title: Shabbir ka matam hain yeh hota hi rahega
body:
har ghar mein bapa gham yuhi hota hi rahega
shabbir ka matam hain yeh hota hi rahega
1. shabbir ka matam hai yeh aijaz hai iska
insaan ki rag rag mein utarta hi rahega
<<DIVIDER>>
2. kubra se kaha peet ke sar bano ne bibi
ujda hai jo ghar aaj wo ujda hi rahega
<<DIVIDER>>
3. lash -e- ali akbar pe kaha shai ne yeh rokar
aankhon mein pisar ab toh andhera hi rahega
<<DIVIDER>>
4. aye hurmul besheer yeh waris hain ali ka
tu teer chala bacha yeh hasta hi rahega
<<DIVIDER>>
5. abbas se jari ho kaha kehti thi yeh zainab
bhaiya tera gham humko rulata hi rahega
<<DIVIDER>>
6. abbas ke haaton ka hi sadqa hain jaha mein
ooncha hain alam aaj bhi ooncha hi rahega
<<DIVIDER>>
7. majboor thi bhai ko kafan dena saki main
yeh zaqm hain wo zaqm jhulasta hi rahega
<<DIVIDER>>
8. khaimon mein lagi aag chini chadare sar se
manzar tha qayamat ka rulata hi rahega
<<DIVIDER>>
9. khismat se mila gham hume shabbir ka logo
hum hoke na ho silsila chalta hi rahega
<<DIVIDER>>
10. shabbir ka matam hain yeh roke na rukega
wada jo wafa hone hain hota hi rahega
<<DIVIDER>>
11.kehte hain katey haat yeh abbas ke sarwat
yeh parcham -e- abbas hain ooncha hi rahega
